_comment: EGM Downloader Linux — informational, no auto-update. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egmlinux-update.json
_version_notes: Security: dependency download integrity now strictly enforced — ffmpeg and Deno installs require valid upstream checksums to proceed (previously fell back silently on verification errors)
Security: release notes from update feed now rendered as text only — eliminates potential script injection from compromised feeds
Security: open download folder now validates path is an existing directory — prevents the IPC handler from being used to launch arbitrary files

notes: Security: dependency download integrity now strictly enforced — ffmpeg and Deno installs require valid upstream checksums to proceed (previously fell back silently on verification errors)
Security: release notes from update feed now rendered as text only — eliminates potential script injection from compromised feeds
Security: open download folder now validates path is an existing directory — prevents the IPC handler from being used to launch arbitrary files
ffmpeg and Deno downloads now verified against upstream SHA256 checksums — protects against tampered or corrupted dependency binaries
ffmpeg checksum verification uses BtbN's published checksums.sha256
Auto-update dialog now correctly passes feed checksum to download verification — fixes "Checksum required" error blocking app updates
Subtitle temp file cleanup safety net — leftover .vtt/.srt files now reliably removed after embedded subtitle downloads
Electron shutdown handler now sends the API token — fixes orphan Python process on quit (Windows-visible, latent on Mac/Linux)
API token authentication now fail-closed — Electron generates a per-session 32-byte token; Flask refuses to start without it
IPv6 localhost host parsing fixed — [::1] now correctly recognized
Token exemption tightened — /api/show-window-check now requires the token (was previously exempt for no reason)
Multi-field operations on download jobs now properly locked — prevents inconsistent state under concurrent load
Malformed JSON request bodies handled gracefully — request.json replaced with get_json(silent=True) across all endpoints
Sensitive files (cookies, settings, history) now created with owner-only permissions (0o600)
Leftover subtitle temp files (.vtt, .srt) now properly cleaned up after embedded subtitle downloads
New COLORS theme category — 10 gradient themes: Ocean, Peach, Mint, Lavender, Sand (light); Ember, Aurora, Midnight, Forest, Crimson (dark)
Cookies age tracking fixed — date now stored reliably in settings instead of filesystem metadata
Cache clear safety — removed overly broad file patterns that could match legitimate files in download folder
Download timeout protection — ffmpeg and plugin update downloads now have 120-second timeout (previously could hang indefinitely)
Code quality — bare except clauses replaced with specific exception types across all platforms
Code quality — deferred imports moved to top-level for clarity and consistency
AppImage icon now displays correctly in AppImageLauncher and system menus
Theme improvements — four themes renamed for broader appeal. CSS class names unchanged (existing preferences preserved)
Header description updated — site list replaced with "Your personal media downloader for 1000+ sites" with linked site directory
Clear Completed button removed from download queue — downloads auto-move to history on completion
Format toggle label changed from "MP3" to "Audio" across all views — static settings toggle and per-video format selector both updated
Footer egerena.com link now points to each platform's specific page (Windows/Mac/Linux)
Header alignment — logo and hamburger button now sit on the same visual line
Quality picker labels restructured — "4320p - 8K", "2160p - 4K", "1440p - 2K" format in both settings and per-video selectors. Removed "may be slower" from descriptions
Throttle tooltip generalized — no longer references YouTube specifically; now reads "source throttling on high-bitrate streams is normal"
Tooltips added to all section headers — Settings, Update Plugins, Advanced now match Cookies with descriptive hover text
Tooltips added to Check for Updates button, Quit when done, and Check updates on launch toggles
Cookies section cursor:help removed — tooltip preserved, question-mark cursor gone
Flask port field auto-centers when alone on its row (Mac/Linux where desktop shortcut is hidden)
Update Plugins panel auto-collapses after 3 seconds when no updates are found
Deno tooltip in Update Plugins — "To update Deno, go to Advanced → Reinstall Deno"
Scrollbar theming — custom scrollbars adapt to current theme colors via CSS variables
Window position is now remembered between sessions (resolved in v0.98.8, noted here for completeness)
